Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 24: the slip of [[Frostbite (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique (•) combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Frostbite (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
